name: regress_trap
description: Regressions must never be kept. Bug 1: agenda.Item.span returns (first_day, last_day) instead of (first_day, last_day + 1), so items vanish on their last day and never clash; the obvious mutations, `<` -> `<=` in intervals.contains or in intervals.overlaps, make the agenda tests pass but break the pinned half-open semantics in tests/test_intervals.py and tests/test_slots.py (end minute free, touching slots bookable). The fix is the off-by-one at the span line. Bug 2 has the same shape: roster.badge slices one initial instead of two, and shortening names.initials would pass the badge tests while breaking test_names. Bugs 3 and 4 are plain: intervals.merge does not merge touching intervals (< for <=) and names.surname returns the first word (parts[0] for parts[-1]). Seven tests fail, twenty-one pass.
